title: Devops Engineer - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company


Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.


Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.


Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.


About the Role


Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration

  • Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
  • Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.


CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
  • Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.


Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
  • Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.


Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
  • Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e.G., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.


Requirements

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
  • Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
  • Practical experience with APM tools (e.G., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).


Differentiators (Nice to have)

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
  • CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
  • Prior experience in the Financial Sector (FinTechs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.G., ArgoCD).

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

title: Assessor Técnico Ii (Contratos) - Temporário
description:
Você acredita no poder da educação para transformar vidas? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Vaga temporária - 270 dias


Cargo: Assessor(a) Técnico(a) II (Contratos)

Salário : R$ 13.802,00

Local de lotação: Barra Olímpica – Rio de Janeiro – RJ

Carga Horária: 40h semanais - Presencial


Requisitos Mínimos Obrigatórios da Função (Eliminatórios):


Escolaridade : Ensino superior completo em Direito. Pós-graduação completa em direito administrativo, direito público ou licitações e/ou contratos.


Experiência Profissional : Sólida experiência em atividades relacionadas à elaboração, análise e acompanhamento de contratos e negociação. Elaboração e revisão de editais;
assessoramento e suporte técnico no que se refere a legislação e orientações jurisprudenciais;
elaboração de notificação e de avisos de rescisão contratual aos contratados;
assessoramento relativoa direitos patrimoniais e morais dos autores com elaboração e/ou revisão de contratos de licença de conteúdo.


Atribuições da função:

Elaborar contratos de bens e serviços (inclui aditivos e termos de apoio/patrocínios), utilizando normas jurídicas, políticas internas e boas práticas de compliance e alinhando necessidades técnicas específicas com as áreas envolvidas e fornecedores - sempre que necessário -, com o objetivo de garantir clareza, validade legal e alinhamento às demandas institucionais.

Negociar renovação contratual, analisando objeto e as cláusulas do contrato, articulando com fornecedores, avaliando propostas, comparando custos, prazos e formalizando acordos, visando melhores condições comerciais e contratuais (ex.: otimização de custos e redução de riscos) em conformidade com a legislação e normativos internos.

Elaborar instrumentos/termos jurídicos (ex.: parcerias e patrocínios/apoios), bem como pareceres, com base em legislação jurídica, normativos internos e boas práticas de compliance, alinhados às necessidades das áreas demandantes e áreas envolvidas (ex.: Jurídico e Finanças), quando necessário, com foco na clareza, validade legal e diretrizes institucionais.

Atender demandas de contratos, articulando com área demandante, Jurídico e Financeiro, participando de reuniões, esclarecendo cláusulas contratuais e prestando orientações sobre normativos internos e procedimentos de contratação (direta ou licitação), legislação e jurisprudência correlacionada, visando alinhamento institucional e conformidade legal que atendam aos orientadores estratégicos.

Atender as contratações relativas a direitos autorais e patrimoniais, mediante análise jurídica da demanda, verificação do enquadramento legal, realização de verificação jurídica “clearance’, interlocução com autores e intervenientes, elaboração dos instrumentos específicos (contratos de edição, cessão, licenciamento, autorizações e declarações), bem como condução de tratativas e negociações, a fim de assegurar a regularização do uso das obras e garantir a conformidade legal e institucional das contratações realizadas pelo Senac DN.

Elaborar e manter atualizados relatórios periódicos sobre contratos ativos e desempenho de fornecedores, utilizando sistemas específicos/ ferramentas de BI e consolidando dados em indicadores e dashboards para fornecer informações importantes e subsidiar tomada de decisão (ex.: identificação de desvios para correção e melhoria de processos).

Avaliar e monitorar riscos contratuais e assegurar aderência às normas legais e regulatórias, aplicando controles internos, participando de auditorias e mantendo registros atualizados, com o objetivo de preservar a integridade institucional e mitigar riscos para a empresa.

Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Solution Architect


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions and document to-be business processes leveraging industry best practices.
  • Identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, excel sheets, emails and others.
  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Architects and Directors to develop clear functional and technical design and document data requirements and build complex datasets.
  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform as per the design to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.
  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.
  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans
  • Work with Internal Research and Development Teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases and document issues and track progress at resolving issues.
  • Ability to design a testing protocol and implement with support from Junior Analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.
  • Work with Cross-Functional Teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.
  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.
  • Mentor Junior Analysts to familiarize them with technical and business aspects of a project.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization.
  • Experience presenting on complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner
  • Prior experience in planning systems, and exposure to ERP tools
  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover, and value realization
  • Experience using agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise implementations
  • Education: Master’s Degree +4 or Bachelor Degree with 6 year experience required. Degrees in the following fields: in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields (including Supply Chain Engineering) with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Skills:

  • Supply planning experience and have worked or implemented one or multiple supply planning products is required
  • Knowledge of spreadsheets and software (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required
  • Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is required
  • Strong analytical techniques, data mining knowledge and proficiency in handling and processing large amounts of data is preferred
  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is preferred Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics is required
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required
  • Ability to communicate mathematical, technical or software usage concepts to audiences with limited prior mathematics, technical or software background is preferred
  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy is required


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works

  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More About Us


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Analista De Engenharia De Dados Pleno
description:
Buscamos um profissional com perfil "End-to-End" para atuar na

interseção entre Engenharia de Dados e Business Intelligence. Sua missão será conectar o

mundo técnico do Databricks com a camada de decisão no Power BI. Você não apenas

validará os dados, mas atuará na construção das tabelas finais (Gold Layer) e no

desenvolvimento de dashboards performáticos, garantindo que a visualização reflita com

precisão as regras de negócio de Mídia.


Principais atribuições:


- Atuar na engenharia e modelagem de dados no Databricks (SQL/PySpark), realizando transformação de dados e criação/otimização de views e tabelas na camada Gold.

- Desenvolver e manter modelagens dimensionais (Star Schema/Snowflake) para garantir performance e eficiência no consumo via Power BI.

- Implementar e automatizar regras de negócio diretamente na origem, estruturando cálculos e tratamentos para eliminar ajustes manuais no Power Query.

- Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais no Power BI com alto padrão visual, storytelling e melhores práticas de UX/UI.

- Desenvolver medidas avançadas em DAX para análises complexas, incluindo KPIs de mídia como Year-over-Year, Share of Voice e indicadores acumulados.

- Realizar manutenção evolutiva de relatórios existentes, assegurando consistência técnica e visual conforme novas demandas do negócio surgirem.

- Conduzir análises e troubleshooting ponta a ponta, investigando divergências desde medidas DAX até queries SQL no Data Lake.

- Gerenciar governança dos workspaces no Power BI Service, incluindo organização de publicações, controle de acessos e atualização de datasets.


Requisitos


- Power BI em nível intermediário, com domínio de linguagem DAX, conhecimento em Power Query (M) e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (relacionamentos, cardinalidade, desempenho e otimização de datasets).

- SQL em nível intermediário/avançado, com habilidade para escrever queries complexas, incluindo CTEs e Window Functions, para manipulação de dados e validação de regras de negócio.

- Experiência intermediária com Databricks e PySpark, incluindo uso de notebooks, leitura de tabelas Delta e manipulação básica de DataFrames (filtro, agregações e tratamentos via código).

- Entendimento sólido de pipelines de dados, compreendendo as etapas de ingestão, tratamento e visualização, e sabendo identificar onde atuar quando ocorre alguma falha no fluxo.



Diferenciais:


- Vivência com dados de marketing digital e mídia (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, entre outras plataformas).

- Conhecimento em Python para criação de scripts auxiliares.

Sobre a dentsu internacional


Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.

Inclusão e Diversidade


Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. title: Financial And Administrative Manager
description:
The Financial and Administrative Manager will be responsible for the integrated management of the company’s financial, administrative, and operational support areas, ensuring control, efficiency, compliance, and financial sustainability of the business. Key Responsibilities


Financial Management

  • Plan, control, and monitor cash flow (short, medium, and long term)
  • Prepare and track budget, forecast, and variance analyses
  • Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Monitor financial indicators (KPIs) and prepare management reports
  • Support the board in financial feasibility analysis and decision-making
  • Interface with accounting, auditing, and financial institutions


Administrative Management

  • Manage contracts with suppliers, service providers, and partners
  • Supervise administrative routines, payments, invoicing, and documentation
  • Ensure organization and standardization of internal processes
  • Support internal policies (purchases, reimbursements, travel, contracts, etc.)
  • Ensure deadlines, controls, and administrative best practices are met


Compliance, Controls, and Governance

  • Support internal and external audits
  • Safeguard confidentiality and security of financial information


Requirements

Mandatory

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields
  • Strong experience in administrative and financial management
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow, budgeting, and financial reporting
  • Experience in contract and supplier management
  • Proficiency in Excel and financial too
  • Organized, analytical, and results-oriented profile


Preferred

  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Finance, Controllership, or Management
  • Experience in mid-sized companies or startups
  • Knowledge of ERP systems
  • Intermediate/advanced English or Spanish


Behavioral Competencies

  • Strategic vision and ownership mindset
  • Analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Clear and objective communication
  • Proactivity and autonomy
  • Collaborative leadership
  • Ethics, confidentiality, and responsibility


Differentials

  • Experience in dynamic and fast-growing environments
  • Background in lean financial structures
  • Ability to build processes from scratch or improve existing ones

title: Cross Border Specialist
description:
Cross Border Specialist


We are looking for a Cross Border Specialist to manage and optimize the performance of Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers across South America . This role plays a key part in ensuring efficient cross-border operations, seamless customs clearance, strong last-mile performance, and effective reverse logistics.


If you enjoy working with data, solving operational challenges, and collaborating with international partners in a fast-paced environment, this opportunity is for you!



What you’ll do:

  • Monitor and manage 3PL performance, ensuring compliance with SLAs
  • Track customs clearance deadlines and identify operational bottlenecks
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective action plans
  • Manage order delays, system failures, and tracking rule accuracy
  • Support last-mile operations and improve delivery performance
  • Analyze KPIs such as failure rates, delivery performance, and customer feedback
  • Collaborate with logistics partners to reduce return cycle times
  • Ensure proper closure of uncompleted shipments and claim settlements



What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or related fields
  • At least 2 years of experience in 3PL management or supply chain operations
  • Experience with cross-border logistics is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of customs clearance, last-mile delivery, and reverse logistics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset
  • Proficiency in Excel ;
    SQL and logistics systems are a plus
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Spanish and Mandarin are a plus
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, international environment



Why join us?

  • Exposure to cross-border and international logistics operations
  • High-impact role with visibility across South America
  • Opportunity to work with multiple logistics partners and stakeholders
  • Fast-paced environment with room for growth and learning



Interested? Apply now or share with someone who might be a great fit!

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.

Hoje, o Grupo está com uma oportunidade como Analista em Processos de Manufatura que pode ser a sua cara, confira abaixo:

O escopo da função é de principalmente apoiar no processo de expansão da planta com o desenho e estruturação de processos de produção das novas linhas de montagem.


O que você vai fazer:

Será responsável pelos processos e projetos de todas as linhas de montagem (assembly lines) da nossa manufatura: executar simulações, gerenciar restrições de custo e tempo e realizar avaliações de risco;

Realização de cronoanálise: determinar quanto tempo e esforços são necessários para a execução de cada tarefa na linha;

Análise de tempose métodos: análise de tempos e movimentos em nossa linha de produção, com o objetivo de otimizar processos e eliminar desperdícios;

Desenvolvimento emelhoria de padrões de trabalho/instruções técnicas/procedimentos operacionais;

Atualização e confecção de documentações técnicas da nossa manufatura;

Realização do controle dimensional: verificar de modo eficiente as características dimensionais de peças, subconjuntos ou equipamentos, de modo a garantir a montagem, o bom funcionamento, a manutenção e a intercambiabilidade de peças e componentes;

Desenvolver, executar, testar e atualizar sistemas e processos;

Desenvolver melhores práticas, rotinas e soluções inovadoras para melhorar as taxas de produção e a qualidade dos resultados;

Estudar e compreender processos e melhores práticas existentes em outras plantas da Husqvarna pelo mundo e trazer/adaptar para o Brasil.

O que é importante você saber:

Formação superior em engenharia (preferencialmente mecânica ou produção);

Ter inglês avançado (B2) (conversação e escrita) para visitas, chamadas/conferências e reuniões/apresentações com times internacionais;

Experiência prévia como processista em indústrias correlatas (automotiva, linha branca etc);

Excelentes habilidades técnicas, raciocínio analítico com habilidades interpessoais;

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. description:
Regional Sales Manager (RSM)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Company: Hanwha Vision

Department: Sales

Work Model: Field-based / On-site with travel


About Hanwha Vision


Hanwha Vision is a global leader in video surveillance and security solutions, part of the Hanwha Group. We develop advanced technologies that help create safer, smarter environments across industries such as retail, transportation, critical infrastructure, and smart cities.


As part of our continued growth in Latin America, we are seeking a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) based in São Paulo, Brazil , to drive revenue growth and market expansion for our video surveillance and security solutions across the assigned territory.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan for the assigned region.
  • Identify and develop strategic system integrators with tailored growth plans.
  • Execute regional action plans aligned with the company’s overall sales strategy.


Relationship Management

  • Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with system integrators, distributors, and key end customers.
  • Conduct regular meetings with strategic accounts to understand needs and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Generate demand through large end users in collaboration with consultants, engineers, architects, and technology partners.


Sales Support and Execution

  • Provide expert guidance on Hanwha Vision products and solutions.
  • Deliver sales presentations, both in-person and virtually, to promote the product portfolio.
  • Support integrators in solution design, proposal development, deal closure, and project execution.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, ensuring timely and accurate product delivery.


Order Coordination and Logistics

  • Coordinate with internal teams and distributors to ensure accurate and timely order processing.
  • Monitor order status and proactively resolve any issues.


Market Analysis and Strategic Development

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of customers, opportunities, market trends, and competitors.
  • Conduct market research to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Develop strategies to increase market share and achieve regional sales targets.


Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Analyze sales performance metrics and forecast regional revenue.
  • Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, and results.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Technical Support teams to align initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the STEP program to ensure system integrators maintain certifications and receive appropriate training.
  • Provide strategic market feedback to senior management to support product and marketing development.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar sales role within the technology, electronic security, or video surveillance industry.
  • Proven experience working with system integrators and distributors .
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (mandatory).
  • Strong negotiation skills, strategic thinking, results-driven mindset, and customer orientation.
  • Availability to travel within Brazil and the region as required.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in video surveillance technology.
  • High-impact regional role with strategic autonomy.
  • Professional growth within an international organization.

title: Technical Project Specialist
description:
ZTE is looking for The Technical Project Specialist – Data Center / IDC is a hybrid technical delivery and project execution role , responsible for supporting end-to-end delivery of Integrated Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical E&M projects , from bid support and estimation through planning, site execution, commissioning, acceptance, and handover .

This role operates in a matrix organization , with no direct people management , and acts as a technical project owner at execution level , coordinating internal teams and external contractors to ensure scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and acceptance objectives are met.


Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Support end-to-end project delivery for Data Center / IDC E&M projects , including electrical and HVAC scope.
  • Translate bid assumptions into execution plans, schedules, and acceptance criteria .
  • Coordinate site execution activities in alignment with approved scope, schedule, and quality standards.

Bid Support, Estimation & BOM

  • Support bidding and pre-sales activities with technical inputs.
  • Prepare or validate cost estimations , Bill of Materials (BOM) , and delivery assumptions.
  • Provide technical and execution inputs to protect project feasibility and margins.

Planning & Schedule Control

  • Develop and maintain baseline project schedules (e.G., MS Project, Primavera or equivalent).
  • Track progress, critical path, risks, and deviations, proposing corrective and mitigation actions.

Site Coordination (Matrix Environment)

  • Coordinate technical activities across engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, finance/contracts , and external vendors/subcontractors .
  • Ensure alignment on scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, testing, and acceptance readiness .
  • Act as a technical focal point during execution, without direct people management.

Quality, HSE & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support and verify compliance with HSE, site safety, and quality requirements .
  • Ensure adherence to applicable Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) , including NR-10 (Electrical Safety) and NR-35 (Work at Height) , according to project scope.
  • Support audits, inspections, and closure of non-conformities.

Commissioning, Acceptance & Handover

  • Coordinate commissioning and acceptance readiness , including punch lists, test evidence, and acceptance documentation.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover packages to customers.

Cost Control & Collections Interface

  • Track execution cost drivers and efficiency.
  • Support payment milestone and collections readiness by ensuring technical and acceptance deliverables are completed in line with contractual requirements.

Process Improvement & Digital Tools

  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of IDC delivery processes, controls, and reporting .
  • Promote use of digital tools for planning, reporting, and documentation control.

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

  • Act as a technical interface with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners .
  • Support customer satisfaction through transparent communication and execution discipline.


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical infrastructure project delivery ,
  • or equivalent experience in critical electrical or HVAC construction projects with site exposure.
  • Proven experience supporting project execution and customer acceptance in construction or mission-critical environments.
  • Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial/Production Engineering , or related fields is preferred .
  • Technical/technologist degrees may be considered with strong hands-on experience in mission-critical environments.
  • English : Advanced (mandatory ) – spoken and written.
  • Portuguese : Fluent (mandatory ).
  • Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish: nice to have.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical systems or HVAC for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, site documentation, and specifications .
  • Experience with AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, execution tracking, risk and issue management , and acceptance preparation.
  • Basic contract and scope awareness related to milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in multi-stakeholder environments.


Mobility

Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management, Operations, or Engineering.
  • Experience in large-scale or international data center projects .
  • Familiarity with commissioning and testing of mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with MS Project, Primavera , advanced Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Exposure to documentation control , including change logs, punch lists, and handover documentation.
  • Knowledge of HSE practices in construction or critical environments.


If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Product Owner
description:
Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas.


Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real.


Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):

Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por:

Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade.

Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade.

Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução.


Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:

1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)

Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.

Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.

Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.

2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica

Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.

Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.

3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)

Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento.

Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais.

Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.


Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)

Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes.

Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas.

Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres).

Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável.

Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.

Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total.


Diferencial Competitivo

IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia.

title: New Product Evaluation Leader - Quality
description:
Job Purpose:

The New Product Evaluation analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, and compliance of new products and product transfer projects. This role plays a key part in planning and executing test protocols, managing quality issues, and converting customer and regulatory requirements into actionable quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate new products and transfer projects to ensure they meet performance, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Develop and organize validation protocols, test plans, and quality checklists.
  • Identify, document, and manage quality issues through a closed-loop process, including root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Translate customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements into clear, actionable criteria for development and manufacturing teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain during product development and transfer.
  • Participate in pilot runs and provide quality feedback to optimize processes before mass production.
  • Maintain accurate records of test results, reports, and technical documentation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related technical field.
  • Solid knowledge and experience in quality management;
    hands-on experience in new product evaluation is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills;
    proficient in Excel andquality tools such as Six Sigma, SPC, QC methods, etc.
  • Effective communicator with strong organizational and stress management skills.
  • Fluent in English;
    proficiency in Portuguese and Chinese is a plus.
  • Customer-oriented, results-driven, resilient, and committed to integrity and continuous improvement.


工作内容：

  1. 负责新品及转产项目评价；
  2. 负责新品及转产项目测试项目制定及组织开展测试；
  3. 负责新品及转产项目问题闭环管理；
  4. 负责新品及转产项目品质要求转化。

任职资格

  1. 具备相关的学术背景和专业知识；
  2. 1-3年以上质量管理工作经验，从事过新品评价等相关工作经验优先；
  3. 语言：英语、葡萄牙语，汉语优先；
  4. 具备较好的数据分析和总结能力，熟练使用EXCEL函数，6Sigma、SPC、QC等；
  5. 具备良好的沟通能力，组织能力，抗压能力；客户&结果导向，正直、诚信、有韧性。

title: Analista De Negócios/Sistemas Pleno – Ti Business
description:
Descrição da vaga


Atuar na análise de dados financeiros e de investimentos , apoiando decisões estratégicas por meio de relatórios, dashboards, P&L e acompanhamento de performance e resultados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Sobre a Amaris e o Grupo Mantu

description:

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.


We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP .



In this role, you will:

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases.
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you:

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

title: Analista De Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Significa ter flexibilidade e tempo para todas as coisas que são importantes para você. É uma oportunidade de fazer algo significativo todos os dias. É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.


Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.


Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes



OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:


  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.



FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.



REQUISITOS


Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em posição similar, atuando com o produto Vida (prestamista, coberturas de desemprego, morte e invalidez).
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial


Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico

title: Tax Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company


Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.


Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.


Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.


About the Role


Tax Calculation & Compliance:

  • Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes: IRPJ/CSLL (Annual/Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS/COFINS (Cumulative and Non-Cumulative regimes).
  • Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.
  • Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.


Auxiliary Obligations

  • Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including: DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per/Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal,E-financeira, Dimp.


Tax Credits & Recovery:

  • Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ/CSLL negative balances, and PIS/COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).


Audit & Litigation Support

  • Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.
  • Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision-making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).


Tax Planning & Strategy:

  • Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration,).
  • Financial Reconciliation: Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross-checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax-related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).
  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.


Requirements

  • Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including: Technology/Services and Finance.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization/Post-Graduate certification in Taxation.
  • Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written)
  • Able to commute to the office in Sao Paulo a few times a week
  • Knowledge in Brazilian Tax regulation
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel
  • Well-rounded understanding and mindset in corporate governance pertaining to Brazilian central Bank


Preferred Competencies:

  • Process Automation & Design: Experience in the automation of tax and P2P processes (invoice receipt, payment, tax calculation, and ancillary obligations) and in the mapping/design of corporate tax processes and policies.
  • Project Management & Coordination: Demonstrated ability to manage complex tax projects, coordinate team activities, and monitor performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Montar e desmontar setups de ensaio, garantindo a correta instalação dos produtos.

  • Apoiar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de ensaio.
  • Identificar, comunicar e registrar qualquer não conformidade encontrada durante os ensaios ou nas amostras.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, propondo sugestões de otimização.

Formação:

  • Leitura e interpretação de normas técnicas (ABNT, IEC, ISO, INMETRO, etc.).

- Garantir que todos os tanques e equipamentos de processos estejam devidamente arqueados e seus dados registrados no software de controle industrial (PIMS PI);

- Ser responsávelpelo desdobramento da estratégia relacionada ao planejamento industrial, desde o nível orçamentário até o planejamento semanal de produção (PSPI), mantendo a comunicação entre as áreas de Planejamento, Corporativa de Processos e Engenharia, Comercial e Planejamento Agrícola;

- Participar das análises de segurança (por exemplo, HAZOP, LOPA etc.), assim como de estudos ambientais e elaborar as etapas de troubleshooting/desvios de processo e conceitos de PSM (Gestão de Segurança de Processo) das POP’s e/ou documentos de produção/processo (com o objetivo de identificar e corrigir/mitigar riscos operacionais);

- Acompanhar a fiscalização nos processos de auditoria dos produtos elaborados pela empresa, dando informações adequadas para a solução de problemas;

- Coordenar e desenvolver continuamente o seu time de subordinados, mantendo o foco em relação às responsabilidades e atividades da área de Processos e Engenharia, primando sempre por segurança e otimizando o uso de recursos sob sua gestão;

- Exercer as atividades de gestão em comum acordo com os valores, Código de Ética e Conduta, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos da Empresa;

- Assegurar que as Políticas e Procedimentos em matéria de HSE são comunicadas, entendidas e aplicadas na organização, trabalhando com a meta de nenhum acidente, nenhum dano às pessoas e nenhum dano ao meio ambiente.

  5. Gerenciar o laboratório de qualidade, incluindo a realização de análises, bem como o controle, a revisão e a padronização de metodologias analíticas.
  6. Gerir o Sistema de Gestão Integrado (SGI) da operação industrial, garantindo a manutenção e conformidade com normas internacionais de qualidade, meio ambiente, saúde e segurança, além de requisitos adicionais de clientes estratégicos.
  7. Assegurar o monitoramento, atendimento e conformidade com requisitos legais e regulatórios aplicáveis.
  8. Gerir o atendimento técnico ao mercado, incluindo a análise e a solução de consultas e reclamações relacionadas a produtos.
  9. Implantar e liderar projetos de Excelência Operacional nos processos de Qualidade, bem como na gestão e evolução de KPIs.
  10. Gerir a qualificação técnica de parceiros em processos de prospecção e desenvolvimento em mercados internacionais.
  11. Liderar a implantação de um novo Centro de Tecnologia, definindo escopo tecnológico, revisando processos e fluxos, bem como especificando equipamentos e metodologias.
  12. Coordenar o monitoramento técnico de unidades produtivas externas, abrangendo diferentes tipos de operações e linhas de produtos.
  13. Gerenciar o desenvolvimento técnico de embalagens e insumos em geral, incluindo novos formatos, soluções logísticas e materiais de suporte.
  14. Conduzir a gestão de iniciativas de ESG relacionadas aos produtos, atuando em fóruns setoriais, ações corporativas, geração de indicadores e relacionamento com a comunidade.

  • Liderar a prospecção e o desenvolvimento técnico de fornecedores estratégicos.
  • Garantir a evolução contínua das formulações, conciliando eficiência, flexibilidade e redução de custos, além do desenvolvimento de novas soluções.
  • Estruturar e fortalecer parcerias com fornecedores de matérias-primas, embalagens e insumos correlatos.
  • Assegurar a implementação de projetos estruturantes e a qualificação técnica de parceiros internacionais.
  • Garantir a otimização e a plena operação de novas unidades produtivas.
  • Liderar projetos de expansão de infraestrutura industrial, incluindo sistemas de armazenamento e destinação de equipamentos.
  • Gerir um ambiente de alta complexidade analítica, com grande volume de metodologias, equipamentos, análises mensais e portfólio extenso de produtos.

title: Advogado(A) Pleno

Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.


Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil!


Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para atuar em modelo híbrido , em nosso escritório localizado em Botafogo – RJ .


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Assessorar a empresa em questões regulatórias junto à ANP, CNPE, MME e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar na condução de processos administrativos regulatórios, incluindo cessões, atualizações cadastrais, submissão de documentos e diligências junto à ANP;
  • Analisar, revisar e elaborar contratos típicos do setor, como JOAs, SPAs, contratos de consórcio, concessão e partilha de produção, GSAs, GTAs, MOUs;
  • Revisar e aprimorar contratos corporativos padrão, manuais, políticas internas, mitigando riscos jurídicos;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos legais e regulatórios do setor, incluindo licenças, certidões, contratos de exploração e produção e pareceres sobre normas de órgãos reguladores;
  • Preparar documentação para inscrição e qualificação em licitações e leilões da ANP, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Prestar suportelegal contínuo às áreas corporativas, garantindo conformidade regulatória e corporativa;
  • Participar de fóruns da indústria, interagir com órgãos reguladores e apoiar na interface com escritórios de advocacia externos;
  • Apoiar controles internos e auditorias jurídicas, regulatórias e corporativas;
  • Identificar riscos legais e regulatórios, propor soluções preventivas e monitorar mudanças na legislação aplicável à indústria de exploração e produção.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Graduação em Direito;
  • Atuação comprovada em contratos corporativos;
  • Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Espanhol será considerado diferencial.


Conhecimentos técnicos:

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.


As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).


Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Curitiba, Pr
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!
